earningsCall.slides_title: First Abu Dhabi Bank Q1 2026 slides
summary: FAB Q1 2026 EPS of 0.43 AED beat estimates by 1.18%; operating income rose 6% YoY to AED 9.34B driven by strong volumes and margin management.
Net profit declined 2% to AED 5.01B due to AED 300M management overlays; excluding overlays, profit would have increased 3% amid external challenges.
Net interest income surged 12% YoY to AED 5.6B while non-interest income fell 2% to AED 3.72B; ROTE of 17.8% exceeded medium-term guidance.
Stock dropped 1.68% to 13.52 AED post-earnings despite beat, reflecting broader market volatility and geopolitical tensions impacting investor sentiment.
FAB maintains 2026 NIM guidance at 180-190 bps; strategic focus on AI adoption, international expansion, and sustainable finance leadership continues.
